opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million. Match funding required: Yes.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities or research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office coordinates applications.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and occasionally to improve access to research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS in the UK, ideally with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000. Match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities managing listed historic sites (Grade I/II*, Category A/B, Grade A/B+, or Scheduled Monument) open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000. Match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities operating accredited museums/galleries holding permanent collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working with disability, ideally with a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities working in mental health, ideally with a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or local authorities providing care and services for older people, ideally with a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000. Match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities operating accredited libraries/archives with permanent collections of national significance and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces in libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000. Match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities focused on professional performance, with performing arts as the vast majority of their activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000. Match funding required if project cost is >£50,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent), local authorities or universities displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance (accredited under Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable).
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000. Maximum grant amount: £100,000. Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK, with at least two years of exam results, a 'Good' or above Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI rating, and demonstrating excellence.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges improve teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music, performing arts). 2026 round closed; decisions November 2026; next round expected spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000. Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) or local authorities running special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, ideally with a 'Good' rating from CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for projects supporting pupils at secondary level in special schools and colleges to develop skills to gain employment or live independently after school or college. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.
